keywords: Verb ば-form + same verb dictionary form + ほど; adjective conditional + adjective + ほど
The more I read this book, the more I like it.
The lighter the luggage, the better.
The quieter the town is, the better I can sleep.
formation: Verb ば-form + same verb dictionary form + ほど; adjective conditional + adjective + ほど
restrictions: Repeat the same predicate; な-adjectives use なら〜なほど.
mistake: The second half describes a changing degree, not simply the next event.
